text: Assessing asset — reading measured identification first, then diagnosing and optimising from evidence only.

Speed is confidently 1542 rpm, but the 30 fps capture puts 25.7 Hz running speed above the 15 Hz Nyquist and the scale is uncalibrated — so shaft-order faults cannot be judged from this data. Reporting those findings before any optimisation.

title: Running speed confirmed — 1542 rpm genset
summary: Bayesian speed MAP 1542.4 rpm (25.71 Hz), 68% CI 1540.0–1544.8 rpm, p_map=0.971 vs ½× alternative 770.9 rpm p=0.029. Display read 1542 rpm, error 0.025%; posterior explains 14/18 peaks under 4-stroke, 50 Hz synchronous genset model.

title: Capture above Nyquist — shaft-order faults not evaluable
summary: 30 fps gives Nyquist 15.0 Hz with near-Nyquist warning, while running speed is 25.74 Hz — 1×, 2× and 3× alias and reported order amplitudes of 0.0 mm/s are non-measurements, not zero vibration. Imbalance P=0.15, misalignment P=0.10, flow P=0.10, bearing P=0.08 and rotor-bar P=0.05 remain at prior with evaluable:false. Needs a calibrated contact capture sampled well above 51.5 Hz (practically ≥200 Hz) plus tach/phase, including phase across coupling.

title: Amplitudes uncalibrated — no ISO 20816 zone assignable
summary: scale_calibrated=false and overall iso_zone=null, so the channel readouts 132.0 mm/s RMS (generator control panel, s1) and 332.0 mm/s RMS (genset enclosure door, s2) must NOT be reported as absolute severity or ISO zone. Amplitudes are relative only; usable ratio is door/panel = 2.51×. Conclusions are based on frequencies, phases and ratios only.

title: Structural modes 2.1–8.7 Hz; no resonance supported in measured band
summary: FDD structural modes at 2.109 Hz (SV ratio 3.25), 3.047 Hz (2.48), 3.984 Hz (ζ=4.39%, SV 6.94, inter-channel phase 125.2°) and 8.672 Hz (ζ=2.49%, SV 20.70, phase 122.4°); residual peak 2.344±0.234 Hz. Campbell criticals empty and resonance posterior P=0.030 with forcing-to-mode separation 1.964 (−6.5 dB). However any mode near 25.7 Hz 1× is above the 15 Hz Nyquist and cannot be excluded from this capture.

title: No support for looseness, combustion imbalance or cavitation-like noise
summary: Evaluable posteriors are down-weighted: looseness P=0.016 (range 0.012–0.016; 2 shaft harmonics 1–10× above 10 dB, −7.2 dB), combustion imbalance P=0.015 (½-order/firing-order ratio 0.02, −8.7 dB), resonance P=0.030. Cavitation index 0.066 with HF energy fraction 0.0144 and HF kurtosis 0.051; audio reports cavitation_like=false, rubbing_or_impacts=false and steady speed. This does not clear the non-evaluable shaft-order faults above Nyquist.

text: No evaluable fault reaches intervention threshold — imbalance is at prior (0.15, not evaluable), so no balancing — and a synchronous genset is normally fixed-speed. Checking the twin optimiser anyway before ruling out a setpoint change.
Optimiser returned 1236 rpm, but that is not credible here — rejecting it rather than proposing it.

title: Optimiser setpoint 1236 rpm rejected — invalid twin inputs, incompatible with synchronous genset
summary: Optimiser claims 1544.3→1236.5 rpm, vibration −19.7%, energy −48.7%, but its current point is 0.1 kW and 0.0001 mm/s from the zero (aliased) orders, so the ISO/resonance passes are vacuous on uncalibrated data. 1236.5 rpm is 19.9% below current and far outside the 50 Hz ±3% synchronous prior — it would change generator output frequency; '80% flow duty'/NPSH framing has no measured basis for this genset. Its only criticals (70 rpm 2× and 141 rpm 1× on 2.34 Hz) also ignore the 3.98/8.67 Hz FDD modes and any mode above 15 Hz Nyquist. No setpoint is proposed.

text: No balancing (imbalance P=0.15, not ≥0.5 and non-evaluable), no skip-bands in the 1544 rpm operating range, and no setpoint/impact to approve. The actionable fix is a proper re-capture, so queuing that as the follow-up.

title: Re-measure genset with calibrated high-bandwidth capture at 1542 rpm
rationale: Current 30 fps capture has 15 Hz Nyquist below the 25.74 Hz running speed and scale_calibrated=false, leaving imbalance/misalignment/bearing/flow non-evaluable and no ISO zone assignable. Re-capture with a calibrated accelerometer sampled ≥200 Hz (preferably ≥1 kHz for bearing/HF content), tach/phase reference and cross-coupling phase, at the generator control panel and enclosure door plus bearing housings, at steady 1542 rpm.

text:
## Assessment — genset at 1542 rpm

**Speed confirmed:** Bayesian MAP **1542.4 rpm (25.71 Hz)**, 68% CI 1540.0–1544.8 rpm, p_map **0.97**. Independent display read **1542 rpm**, error **0.025%** — the 4-stroke, 50 Hz synchronous, 4-pole-class kinematics explain 14/18 peaks. No kinematic ambiguity requiring a what-if test.

**Evidence limits (decisive):**
- Capture is 30 fps → Nyquist **15.0 Hz**, below the 25.74 Hz running speed. 1×/2×/3× alias; the reported 0.0 mm/s orders are non-measurements.
- `scale_calibrated=false`, overall ISO zone `null`. The 132.0 vs 332.0 mm/s channel figures are **relative only** (door/panel ratio 2.51×) — no ISO 20816 zone or absolute severity is claimed.
- Consequently imbalance (P=0.15, prior only), misalignment (P=0.10), bearing (P=0.08), flow (P=0.10) and rotor-bar (P=0.05) are `evaluable:false`. I am not concluding on them from this capture.

**What the valid band supports:** Structural modes at **2.109, 3.047, 3.984 Hz (ζ=4.39%)** and **8.672 Hz (ζ=2.49%)**, plus residual peak 2.344±0.234 Hz. Looseness P=0.016, combustion imbalance P=0.015, resonance P=0.030 — all down-weighted. Cavitation index 0.066, HF fraction 0.014, audio non-cavitation-like, speed steady. Any mode near 1× (25.7 Hz) remains unexcluded above Nyquist.

## Optimisation decision

The optimiser returned **1544.3 → 1236.5 rpm**, claiming −19.7% vibration / −48.7% energy. **Rejected — no setpoint proposed:**
- Its current point (0.1 kW, 0.0001 mm/s) derives from the zero aliased orders on an uncalibrated scale, so its ISO and resonance “passes” are vacuous.
- 1236 rpm is ~20% below a 50 Hz synchronous genset speed and would change output frequency; the “80% flow duty” constraint has no measured basis here.
- Its exclusion bands (63.3–77.3 and 126.6–154.7 rpm) sit far below the operating point and ignore the 3.98/8.67 Hz modes.

## Actions

- **No balancing** (imbalance P=0.15 < 0.5 and non-evaluable), **no skip-bands** (no resonance band in the operating range), **no work order** (no supported leading fault).
- **Queued follow-up `a89e79`, due 2027-02-02:** calibrated contact re-measurement at steady 1542 rpm, sampled ≥200 Hz (preferably ≥1 kHz), with tach/phase and cross-coupling phase at bearing housings, panel and door.
